# Danny On The Air (danny.vn)

> Personal site of Danny, a security engineer in Vietnam who builds open-source security automation, evidence-based regulatory and compliance tools, Go SDKs, and systems research.

## Security as Code

These tools pull live security platform state into files for review, diff, and approved changes. All three include a built-in Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and mutations are dry-run by default.

- [splunkctl](https://github.com/dannyota/splunkctl): Splunk Enterprise SIEM and Splunk SOAR as code
- [s1ctl](https://github.com/dannyota/s1ctl): SentinelOne Singularity as code
- [secopsctl](https://github.com/dannyota/secops): Google SecOps, including Chronicle SIEM and Siemplify SOAR, as code

## Regulatory AI

One codebase, one corpus per country, across six ASEAN jurisdictions. Each public endpoint finds exact provisions in official sources and links results to the source text. The endpoints use Streamable HTTP, are free, and require no signup. Tools: search, document, corpus_status, quality_gaps, guide.

- [banhmi](https://banhmi.danny.vn): Vietnamese banking and fintech regulation (MCP: banhmi.danny.vn/mcp; ask in Vietnamese)
- [laksa](https://laksa.danny.vn): Malaysian banking and fintech regulation (MCP: laksa.danny.vn/mcp; ask in English)
- [rendang](https://rendang.danny.vn): Indonesian banking and fintech regulation (MCP: rendang.danny.vn/mcp; ask in Indonesian)
- [kaya](https://kaya.danny.vn): Singaporean banking and fintech regulation (MCP: kaya.danny.vn/mcp; ask in English)
- [tomyum](https://tomyum.danny.vn): Thai banking and fintech regulation (MCP: tomyum.danny.vn/mcp; ask in Thai)
- [amok](https://amok.danny.vn): Cambodian banking and fintech regulation (MCP: amok.danny.vn/mcp; ask in English)

## Compliance AI

- [compliary](https://github.com/dannyota/compliary): exact control citations, version lineage, and sourced cross-framework mappings for ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27002, ISO/IEC 27017, ISO/IEC 27018, ISO/IEC 27701, ISO 22301, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST SP 800-53 r5, SOC 2, PCI DSS v4.0.1, CIS Controls v8.1, SWIFT CSCF, CSA CCM v4.1, and COBIT 2019. Framework text is licensed, so each operator builds and runs a private corpus.

## Go SDKs

- danny.vn/s1: SentinelOne Singularity
- danny.vn/secops: Google SecOps
- danny.vn/fortigate: FortiGate firewall REST API
- danny.vn/fortimgr: FortiManager FlatUI API
- danny.vn/nessus: Tenable Nessus scanner (read-only)
- danny.vn/vngcloud: VNG Cloud IAM
- danny.vn/gnode: VNG Cloud GreenNode services (unofficial community SDK)
- danny.vn/kaggle: Kaggle API

## Open Source

- [onnxruntime/go](https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/pull/29615): official Go bindings for the ONNX Runtime C API via CGO, merged into microsoft/onnxruntime
- [offthebook](https://github.com/dannyota/offthebook): memory-only Windows PE execution, loader-state reconstruction, and SMB-over-QUIC SEC_IMAGE loading in pure C
- [splunk-sdk-python](https://github.com/dannyota/splunk-sdk-python): Splunk SDK for Python
- [flowcvcli](https://github.com/dannyota/flowcvcli): FlowCV resume control from the command line or Python
- All repositories: https://github.com/dannyota
